pr_body:
Closes: #7235

### Description of change

- Allow `delete().returning()` on MariaDB >= 10.0.5
- Allow `insert().returning()` on MariaDB >= 10.5.0
- Can check DML type(ex: `select`, `update`, `delete`) on
  `Driver.isReturningSqlSupported()` and `QueryBuilder.createReturningExpression()`

- [x] Code is up-to-date with the `master` branch

- [x] `npm run test` passes with this change

comments: What version is this available from?

> INSERT ... RETURNING was added in MariaDB 10.5.0, and returns a resultset of the inserted rows.

From [Official document](https://mariadb.com/kb/en/insertreturning/)
If underlying driver (e.g. mysql package that is used for mariadb) support this - feature is relatively easy to implement. Feel free to contribute
